specials.txt: The iRacing ROAR is inspired by the real-world Roar Before the Rolex 24 at Daytona International Speedway. Back by popular demand, this event kicks off the 2026 iRacing Special Event schedule.

The event marks the ninth running of the anniversary of iRacing’s popular driver swap/team feature that sees hundreds of teams of iRacing drivers, team managers, engineers, and spotters participate in the around the clock sim race. The 24 Hours of Daytona is a 24 hour endurance race held at Daytona International Speedway in Daytona Beach, Florida. It is the opening round of the IMSA Michelin Endurance Cup in the IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship.

Known as “The Great American Race,” the iRacing Daytona 500 serves as part of the NASCAR iRacing Series schedule. It’s one of four full-length events in the championship, which mirrors the real-world NASCAR Cup Series campaign with 36 events throughout the year.

The Bathurst 12 Hour is a 12 hour endurance race staged on the Mount Panorama Circuit in Bathurst, New South Wales, Australia. This event serves as the opening round to the Intercontinental GT Challenge Series in the real world.

The Sebring 12HR is a 12-hour endurance race held at Sebring International Raceway in Sebring, Florida. It is the second round of the IMSA Michelin Endurance Cup in the IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship.

Travel back in time to an era of classic sports car racing with the IMSA Classic 500 at WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca that was revived as part of the IMSA GT Championship in 1979. Racers will get to experience the excitement racing the Nissan GTP ZX-T or the Audi 90 Quattro GTO.

specials.autos: GT3 // Porsche Cup // GT4 // TCR // BMW M2 CS Racing
specials.txt: The 24 Hours Nürburgring (ADAC 24h Rennen Nürburgring) is a 24-hour endurance event held on the Nürburgring Combined – Gesamtstrecke 24h in Nürburg, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany. It also utilizes part of the GP-Strecke course to form a total lap length of 16.1 miles (25.9 km).

Known as “The Greatest Spectacle in Racing,” the INDY 500 is one of the most prestigious race events in the world, held since 1911 at Indianapolis Motor Speedway. It is part of the INDYCAR Series in the United States.

The final marquee motorsport event of Memorial Day weekend and a longtime Charlotte Motor Speedway tradition, the iRacing World 600 serves as part of the NASCAR iRacing Series schedule. It’s the second of four full-length events in the championship, which mirrors the real-world NASCAR Cup Series campaign with 36 events throughout the year.
Get your team together for this 4 hour endurance race in the Touring Cars around Thruxton which has been referred to as "The fastest circuit in the UK".

The 6 Hours of the Glen Powered by VCO is a 6 hour endurance race held annually at Watkins Glen International in Watkins Glen, New York. It is the third round of the IMSA Michelin Endurance Cup in the IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship.

The Firecracker 400 was a NASCAR Winston Cup Series racing event that took place at Daytona International Speedway. Take a step back in time to feel what it was like to race in this Legendary event with the Historic 1987 NASCAR Cup Cars.
The 24 Hours of Spa is an endurance race held in Belgium at Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps since 1923. It is part of the Intercontinental GT Challenge Series in the real world.

The Brickyard 400 remains on the iRacing Special Event Calendar in 2026. Indianapolis Motor Speedway has played host to the Brickyard 400 in the NASCAR Cup series since 1994. It’s the third of four full-length events in the NASCAR iRacing Series Schedule.
The 6 Hours of the Road America is a 6 hour endurance race held annually at Road America. It is the fourth round of the IMSA Michelin Endurance Cup in the IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship.

The Knoxville Nationals is one of the biggest and most prestigious Sprint Car events of the year. The World of Outlaws Sprint Car Series event is held annually at Knoxville Raceway in Knoxville, Iowa.

The Portimao 1000 was run for the first time in 2009 in International Sports Car competition. Revisit these classic sports cars around Algarve International Circuit, in Portugal for 1000km in a team racing format.

The Crandon Pro 4 Championship is held annually on Labor Day weekend at Crandon International Raceway. Independently sanctioned and with no points on the line, it attracts the best off-road racers from various series across the United States.

A longtime Labor Day tradition, the Southern 500 at Darlington Raceway serves as part of the NASCAR iRacing Series schedule. It’s the third of four full-length events in the championship, which mirrors the real-world NASCAR Cup Series campaign with 36 events throughout the year.

The Suzuka 1000km, is an annual sports car endurance race that has been held at the Suzuka Circuit in Japan since 1966. After a five-year hiatus, the event returned in September 2025 as part of an International GT Series.
The Britcar 24 Hour was a sports car race in endurance racing, held annually at Silverstone Circuit in the United Kingdom until 2018.

The Petit Le Mans is a 10 hour endurance race held annually at Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta in Braselton, Georgia. It is the final round of the IMSA Michelin Endurance Cup in the IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship.

The Bathurst 1000 is staged on the Mount Panorama Circuit in Bathurst, New South Wales, Australia. Regarded as the pinnacle of motorsport in Australia, this is the biggest event on the calendar for the Supercars Series.

The 8 Hours of Indianapolis is an 8 hour endurance race held at Indianapolis Motor Speedway in Indiana. POSTER MORE INFO BROADCAST LEARN MORESIGN UP!Race NASCAR, dirt, rallycross and more. iRacing has partnered with the premier names in motorsports – NASCAR, USAC, World of Outlaws, IMSA and more!

The iRacing CONSPIT FF1600 Festival is an event that will be emulating the Formula Ford Festival run in real life utilizing the same heat racing format. The event will take place at Brands Hatch on the Indy layout.

Mirroring the real-world NASCAR Cup Series finale from Homestead-Miami Speedway, the iRacing Homestead Championship wraps up the 2026 NASCAR iRacing Series schedule. It’s the last of four full-length events in the championship, which mirrors the real-world NASCAR Cup Series campaign with 36 events throughout the year.
The Super Formula Lights take on Mount Panorama Circuit in the iRacing Mountain Showdown Special Event for the very first time.

The SCCA National Championship Runoffs is the end-of-year championship meeting for Sports Car Club of America Club Racing competitors. Take part in one of the many car classes in a week long qualification and super session format. TBA

This 12-hour event will feature a single-class format using the Porsche 911 Cup (992.2), offering a focused endurance challenge to close out the season. The event will utilize standard iRacing special event time slots.

The Winter Derby is held at Five Flags Speedway in Pensacola, Florida. Considered to be the most prestigious Super Late Model race, the annual event draws the nation’s best short track racers for a 300 lap showdown on the half mile.

The Chili Bowl is held every January at the Tulsa Expo Center in Tulsa, Oklahoma. The biggest midget race of the year, it attracts hundreds of drivers from all types of racing attempting to work their way through a week of preliminary rounds and an alphabet soup of main events to get to the 55-lap A main.
A 4 hour endurance race using the Production Car Challenge cars at the ViR Grand Course. It can be run solo or with a team.
